<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CampaignStart" name="Campaign process started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives (target audience and goals)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CreationSplit" name="Start content, visuals and channel selection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design visuals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels (digital ads, emails, social media posts)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CreationJoin" name="Content, visuals and channels completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time (click-through rates, conversions)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Sales team follows up on leads"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded" name="Campaign concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CampaignStart" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Gateway_CreationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_CreationSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_CreationSplit" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_CreationSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Gateway_CreationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Gateway_CreationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Gateway_CreationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_CreationJoin" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
